UPDATE session_queued_messages SET
                   state = 'queued',
                   failure_reason = 'delivery interrupted; queued for retry',
                   claude_session_id = NULL,
                   pasted_at = NULL,
                   updated_at = datetime('now', 'subsec')
               WHERE state = 'pasting'
                 AND julianday(updated_at) <= julianday($1)
